Arcana cards are a modifier system in Vampire Survivors. Obtaining the

The rest of the Arcanas in the base set are unlocked by reaching level 50 with certain characters, or by reaching the 31:00 mark in certain stages. Obtaining the
in Room 1665 unlocks an additional set of "Darkanas", allowing even more Arcanas to be unlocked by achieving specific tasks with certain other characters.
Each Arcana modifies gameplay in a particular way. The player can choose to enable or disable Arcanas in the stage selection screen.
With Arcanas enabled, the player can obtain up to three Arcanas over the course of a run (although through certain means, more than three can be obtained):
At the beginning of a run, the player is allowed to choose one of any unlocked Arcanas or Darkanas. They are also given the option to select a random one.
At 11:00 and 21:00, a special boss will spawn that, upon death, who drops an

Arcana Chest. Upon being picked up, the chest will allow the player to choose an additional Arcana. The menu offers four or more randomly chosen Arcanas from the uncollected Arcanas. The player may spend
to get new choices until all options have been displayed, and unlike normal level ups, previous options will not be offered again.
If the player has three or more Arcanas, the Arcana bosses will instead drop regular chests. If Arcanas are disabled, the Arcana bosses will not appear in the stage.

If the player has unlocked a total of 23 or more Arcanas or Darkanas (which requires unlocking at least one Darkana), Arcana Chests will instead offer six random Arcanas as opposed to four, and each Arcana Chest will allow the player one free Reroll.
In stages where the time limit is not 30:00, the Arcana bosses may appear at different times. In
, and
, the bosses instead spawn at 5:00 and 10:00.
Some characters automatically start with Arcana effects, such as

; these Arcana effects do not take up an Arcana slot, and they will still be present if Arcanas are disabled.
There is no limit to the amount of Arcanas a player can have at one time, although more unique methods are required for obtaining more than three.

If Inverse mode is active, the
Merchant will sell an Arcana for
20,000, regardless of how many Arcanas the player currently has. All unlocked Arcanas are available as choices.

With Endless mode enabled, the Merchant will respawn with another for sale at the start of each normal game length cycle (30 min in most stages). This can be repeated until all unlocked Arcanas are collected.
Treasure Chests dropped by bosses spawned by
can occasionally contain Arcanas. This chance remains until all unlocked Arcanas have been collected.
There are 22 regular Arcanas total. Each Arcana is represented by a Roman numeral.
Darkanas were introduced in patch 1.11 and are unlocked by obtaining the
found due south in Room 1665. There are currently 13 Darkanas total. Each Darkana is also represented by a Roman numeral.

While Darkanas often share similar themes to their "counterpart" Arcanas, whether or not they are meant to be the inverse or opposite of Arcana is merely speculation, and has never been confirmed. However, this is likely false, as the patch notes for the same version that introduced Darkana state "The only difference between Arcanas and Darkanas is their theme, functionally they are exactly the same," [1] with no other confirmation toward this intention being given.
